review_notes: Rockgeist is a made-to-order maker in Asheville NC, so a third of this catalogue is a configurable platform rather than a fixed SKU. Where that is true the record fixes what is actually fixed - silhouette, closure, zip and strap layout, spine width - and says so in dims_note.

Two material families and they must not be blurred. The sewn line (Cache, Gondola, Foxglove, Honeypot, Honeybox, Stake, Dr. Jones, all custom framebags) is X-Pac / ECOPAK / Ultra laminate with a very visible ripstop grid under a glossy face film - that should drive a normal map, not just a colour. The welded line (Nigel, Horton, Meanwhile, Mr. Fusion dry bag, Microwave dry bag, all 52Hz) is matte coated fabric with NO grid and welded seams.

Biggest single find: the 52Hz galleries contain dimensioned PANEL DIAGRAMS that a previous pass recorded as not existing. The Wedge's are per-size and have been used; the four full-frame models share one unlabelled diagram per model and have not.
Two products are not free-standing: the Meanwhile needs a wire basket, the Microwave needs a rack. The Loop Bar Harness needs a loop handlebar. The Horton needs a bar roll underneath it.

geometry.notes: Made to the customer's frame, so the outline is the frame's main triangle: long top-tube edge, short head-tube edge at the front, long down-tube edge, tall seat-tube edge at the rear, with the BB corner cut away. products.dims_raw: (made to order; no dimensions or volume published)
products.dims_note: Made to order to the customer's top-tube length, so nothing here is published. The stored 40 cm is if anything short - the studio and on-bike photos show the bag running the FULL stem-to-seatpost span, which on a medium frame is nearer 50-55 cm. Left unchanged and flagged rather than guessed.

geometry.notes: Runs the entire top tube. The top line is NOT flat - it is stepped/wavy: taller at the stem end, dipping through a shallow waist in the middle where the rider's knees pass, and rising again at the seatpost end. Squared ends. That profile is the product's signature and a plain box will not read as this bag.

logo.notes: square woven black/grey ROCKGEIST mountain-range patch

mount.notes: Sits ON TOP of the top tube, anchored at both ends as well as along its length. Because it spans stem to seatpost the knee clearance in the middle is the whole reason for the dipped waist.
